withhold_threshold.quote: Prior to dosing, withhold TEMOZOLOMIDE until patients have an absolute neutrophil count (ANC) of 1.5 x 10^9/L or greater and a platelet count of 100 x 10^9/L or greater.

maintenance_withhold.quote: Withhold TEMOZOLOMIDE if ANC less than 1 x 10^9/L.
maintenance_withhold.section: DOSAGE MODIFICATIONS DURING MAINTENANCE TREATMENT, Table 2

regimen.quote: Cycle 1: 150 mg/m2 per day on days 1 to 5

regimen_cycle.quote: The recommended initial dosage of TEMOZOLOMIDE is 150 mg/m2 once daily on Days 1 to 5 of each 28-day cycle.

nadir_day.quote: the median nadirs occurred at 26 days for platelets (range: 21 to 40 days) and 28 days for neutrophils (range: 1 to 44 days)

not_cumulative.quote: myelosuppression usually occurred during the first few cycles of therapy and was generally not cumulative

myelosuppression_model.second_drug_potency: ASSUMED; swept over declared values, never set to zero to admit a calendar

anchors.cycles_non_cumulative_ratio_note: 1.0 means the deepest later-cycle nadir equals the first cycle's; the label states myelosuppression 'was generally not cumulative'

provenance.myelosuppression: DECLARED ASSUMPTION: real arithmetic on assumed parameters; not an NCCN, FDA or label threshold; not measured in this repository

provenance.clinical_outcome: NOT CLAIMED: no schedule here is shown to help a patient; the engine is simulation-only
